import msal
import requests


def register_user(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    response = requests.post('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']},
        json={'accountEnabled': True, 'displayName': payload['email'],
              'identities': [{'signInType': 'emailAddress', 'issuer': config['issuer'],
                              'issuerAssignedId': payload['email']}],
              'passwordProfile': {'password': payload['password'], 'forceChangePasswordNextSignIn': False},
              'passwordPolicies': 'DisablePasswordExpiration'}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'user_id': response.json()['id']}

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass
+class IdentityConfig:
+    tenant_id: str
+    client_id: str
+    client_secret: str
+    issuer: str
+    openai_api_key: str = ''
+    pinecone_api_key: str = ''
+    pinecone_index: str = ''
+
+
+def load_identity_config(config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    return IdentityConfig(
+        tenant_id=config.get('tenant_id') or os.environ['AZURE_TENANT_ID'],
+        client_id=config.get('client_id') or os.environ['AZURE_CLIENT_ID'],
+        client_secret=config.get('client_secret') or os.environ['AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET'],
+        issuer=config.get('issuer') or os.environ['AZURE_B2C_ISSUER'],
+        openai_api_key=config.get('openai_api_key') or os.environ.get('OPENAI_API_KEY', ''),
+        pinecone_api_key=config.get('pinecone_api_key') or os.environ.get('PINECONE_API_KEY', ''),
+        pinecone_index=config.get('pinecone_index') or os.environ.get('PINECONE_INDEX', ''),
+    )
+
+
+def identity_settings(config=None):
+    loaded = load_identity_config(config)
+    return {
+        'tenant_id': loaded.tenant_id,
+        'client_id': loaded.client_id,
+        'client_secret': loaded.client_secret,
+        'issuer': loaded.issuer,
+        'openai_api_key': loaded.openai_api_key,
+        'pinecone_api_key': loaded.pinecone_api_key,
+        'pinecone_index': loaded.pinecone_index,
+    }

+def normalize_email(email):
+    return (email or '').strip().lower()
+
+
+def normalize_locale(locale):
+    return (locale or 'en').strip().replace('_', '-').lower()
+
+
+def build_email_password_payload(payload):
+    payload = payload or {}
+    return {
+        'email': normalize_email(payload.get('email')),
+        'password': payload.get('password', ''),
+    }
+
+
+def build_locale_payload(payload):
+    payload = payload or {}
+    return {
+        'text': payload.get('text', ''),
+        'locale': normalize_locale(payload.get('locale')),
+    }
+
+
+def build_support_payload(payload):
+    payload = payload or {}
+    return {
+        'user_id': payload.get('user_id', ''),
+        'email': normalize_email(payload.get('email')),
+        'status': payload.get('status', ''),
+    }

+import msal
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+from identity_models import build_email_password_payload
+
+
+def email_password_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = load_identity_config(config)
+    payload = build_email_password_payload(payload)
+    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
+        config.client_id,
+        authority=f'https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config.tenant_id}',
+        client_credential=config.client_secret,
+    )
+    token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
+    if 'access_token' not in token:
+        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
+    response = requests.post(
+        'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/validatePassword',
+        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']},
+        json={'email': payload['email'], 'password': payload['password']},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return {'access_token': token['access_token'], 'refresh_token': token.get('refresh_token', ''), 'user': response.json()}

+import msal
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+
+
+def refresh_session(payload, config=None):
+    config = load_identity_config(config)
+    payload = payload or {}
+    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
+        config.client_id,
+        authority=f'https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config.tenant_id}',
+        client_credential=config.client_secret,
+    )
+    token = app.acquire_token_silent(['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'], account=None)
+    if not token or 'access_token' not in token:
+        token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
+    if 'access_token' not in token:
+        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph session refresh failed')
+    return {'access_token': token['access_token'], 'refresh_token': token.get('refresh_token', payload.get('refresh_token', ''))}

+
+

+        'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/sendMail',
